license_note: The repository LICENSE file is the unmodified Apache License 2.0 text and governs the published weights, tokenizer, and chat template. A separate USAGE_POLICY file asks users to comply with applicable law but adds no use-based restrictions beyond the license, so the release is open source.

license_evidence.scope: openai/gpt-oss-20b model weights, tokenizer, chat template, and original and Metal checkpoint artifacts

access_boundary: This record represents the openai/gpt-oss-20b weight release at Hugging Face commit 6cee5e81ee83917806bbde320786a8fb61efebee, last modified 2025-08-26. The gpt-oss-120b sibling, downstream quantizations and fine-tunes, and independent hosting providers remain separate boundaries; OpenAI serves no managed API for this model.
strengths: OpenAI publishes Safetensors, original checkpoint, and Metal artifacts in one ungated repository with a repository license file
The 20B sizing runs within 16 GB of memory with documented Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, Ollama, LM Studio, and Docker paths, and the smaller model can be fine-tuned on consumer hardware
tradeoffs: Neither the model card nor OpenAI's docs page carries dated release notes or a deprecation posture, so version identity rests on repository commits
OpenAI's docs page is reference-only with zero rate limits, so every deployment is self-operated or third-party
